dq_checks.name: pk_unique_events
dq_checks.description: events.event_id is unique

dq_checks.name: pk_unique_sessions
dq_checks.description: sessions.session_id is unique

dq_checks.name: required_fields_not_null
dq_checks.description: no NULL required fields in events

dq_checks.name: ri_events_users
dq_checks.description: every event.user_id exists in dim_users

dq_checks.name: ri_sessions_users
dq_checks.description: every session.user_id exists in dim_users

dq_checks.name: every_event_sessionized
dq_checks.description: every valid event is assigned to exactly one session

dq_checks.name: no_orphan_session_events
dq_checks.description: every session_events row points to an existing session and event

dq_checks.name: session_event_count_matches
dq_checks.description: sessions.event_count equals the number of mapped events

dq_checks.name: total_events_reconcile
dq_checks.description: SUM(sessions.event_count) equals COUNT(events)

dq_checks.name: session_bounds_match_events
dq_checks.description: session start/end equal min/max event time of its events

dq_checks.name: duration_consistent
dq_checks.description: duration_seconds = (end - start) and is non-negative

dq_checks.name: intra_session_gap_within_limit
dq_checks.description: no gap inside a session exceeds the inactivity gap

dq_checks.name: inter_session_gap_exceeds_limit
dq_checks.description: consecutive sessions of a user are separated by more than the gap

dq_checks.name: sessions_use_current_gap
dq_checks.description: all sessions were computed with the configured gap (else run --rebuild-sessions)

dq_checks.name: no_pending_sessionization
dq_checks.description: no user is waiting for session recomputation

dq_checks.name: user_session_seq_contiguous
dq_checks.description: user_session_seq runs 1..n without gaps per user

dq_checks.name: rejects_traceable
dq_checks.description: every rejected record has source file, hash, line and reason

dq_checks.name: file_counts_reconcile
dq_checks.description: per file in this run: rows_read = inserted + duplicate + already_loaded + rejected

dq_checks.name: file_rejects_persisted
dq_checks.description: per successful file: rows_rejected + rows_duplicate equals quarantined rows for that file

dq_checks.name: file_inserts_persisted
dq_checks.description: per successful file: rows_inserted + rows_already_loaded equals events stored from that file
